parent_objective: audit M2404 bounded repair-plan materialization and choose one bounded next route
blocked_by: M2404 materializes repair-plan rows but does not audit whether implementation is admissible
offtrack repair plans must not bypass collision and R4 guardrails
the next route must not jump directly to repair execution without audit
supersedes: direct repair implementation from M2404 rows without audit
candidate/profile ranking from diagnostic monitoring rows
scenario-redesign or training-repair claims from repair-plan artifacts

public_gates: M2405 must audit M2404 plan completeness and guardrail separation
M2405 must decide whether to admit one bounded implementation route, pivot to scenario-quality reassessment, or stop
M2405 must keep diagnostic rows non-ranking
M2405 must not execute repair, train, rerun measured validation, rank candidates/profiles, overwrite active configs, or make scenario-redesign/training-repair/paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun M2397 M2399 M2401 or M2404
do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2404 produced an admissible bounded repair-plan route without executing repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no repair execution, training, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2404 plan rows are incomplete or inconsistent with M2401 counts
stop if offtrack, collision, and R4 rows are not separated
stop if implementation would require candidate/profile ranking
stop if implementation would require actor input contract changes or hidden/oracle features
stop if the only admissible route is scenario semantics rather than driver/controller repair
fallback_plan: admit one bounded implementation route only if plan completeness and guardrails pass
pivot to scenario-quality reassessment if plan rows show the blocker is task construction
route to artifact repair only if M2404 outputs are structurally invalid
stop for user review if no bounded non-ranking route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2404 materialized a bounded repair-plan artifact

admission_evidence: M2404 repair_execution_allowed_count training_allowed_count ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count and guardrail_violation_count are 0
allowed_updates: M2405 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit or branch stop
next_stage_criteria: M2404 completeness is accepted or rejected
guardrail separation is accepted or rejected
one bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2405 audits a repair-plan artifact and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2405; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2404 only supports scenario-quality changes, pivot instead of calling it driver repair.
allowed_claims: M2404 bounded repair-plan completeness accepted or rejected

no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits whether M2404 converted target categories into an implementation-admissible plan
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit a bounded implementation route but cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2405 cannot choose a bounded implementation pivot or stop route
M2405 proposes another artifact-only planning step before implementation decision
M2405 attempts to rank candidates or profiles
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: The M2404 repair-plan artifact can be audited into an implementation-admissible bounded route, scenario-quality pivot, or stop decision without executing repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2404 completeness and guardrail separation are accepted or rejected with explicit counts
one bounded follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2405 reruns rollout or executes repair/training/replay/PPO
M2405 ranks candidates, ranks profiles, or selects a winner
M2405 treats repair-plan materialization as repair or scenario redesign success
M2405 makes paper finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: audit

decision_rule: M2405 passes if it audits M2404 into an explicit bounded next-route decision without repair execution, ranking, or verdict claims.
